contamination_risks: Every development event scope is already globally exposed and is restricted to contaminated training.
Confirmation is event-wise reserved and must be rechecked against the global outcome-exposure index before access.
family_contract.entry_rule: For pre-market or after-market Item 2.02 filings only, observe the full reaction session; require frozen gap, confirmation, close-location, price, liquidity, and cost-floor gates; rank one issuer per day; enter the next session open.

execution_assumptions.entry: next session open after full reaction close

family_contract.exit_rule: Exit at the stop or the close of the second or fifth session, with a five-session absolute maximum.
family_contract.expected_holding_behavior: Enter the session after a completed positive earnings reaction and hold at most five sessions under an ATR structural stop.

falsifiers.confirmation: exact frozen winner fails untouched evidence
falsifiers.implementation: any rule, capture, or hash violation

family_contract.material_difference_rationale: This combines a verified activist issuer-state mechanism with actual SEC Item 2.02 acceptance timestamps and completed reaction bars; it is not the retired Schedule 13D disclosure-day continuation rule or the retired 10-Q EPS fact family.
family_contract.mechanism: After an issuer enters a point-in-time verified Schedule 13D activist universe, a later SEC Item 2.02 earnings reaction may continue because activist pressure can prolong repricing and capital-allocation demand.
family_contract.primary_outcome: Selection-adjusted chronological net account growth after 5/10/20-bps per-side costs.
production_compatibility_risks: SEC acceptance and filing identity must be fresh and point-in-time.
Overnight positions require confirmed GTC protection and gap-risk sizing.
Sparse signals may make the frozen power target infeasible.
family_contract.ranking_rule: Higher reaction opening gap, then higher close location, then higher reaction dollar volume, then canonical symbol.
family_contract.selection_rule: Evaluate every frozen trial through rolling-origin OOF account paths and apply the repository development-search winner rule exactly.
family_contract.stop_rule: Stop 1.0 or 1.5 ATR14 below entry; nonpositive, missing, or otherwise invalid structural stops are rejected; same-interval ambiguity is stop-first.

universe_requirements.identity: point-in-time verified Schedule 13D issuer symbol interval
